main_body: A fenced farm plot: a wooden post-and-rail fence enclosing a field of crop rows (wheat, greens, cabbages, seedlings), seen mostly as a flat top-down plan with rails drawn as front-facing bands.
top_band: Column at x~30 through the north fence: tan rail bands (rows 2-6, 9-12) with dark brown below; the rails are vertical front-facing planks, not a top surface. The field itself is a flat plan from row 16 to 80.
evidence: The crop field is a flat map-like plan with no front face or standing volume. The fence posts and rails are drawn in elevation, so no horizontal beam top or base reads as a surface seen from above. It is not an open frame or rack; it is a ground patch with a fence ring. It does not follow the 3/4 contract of a top band plus a front face.

style.evidence: The reference pieces are a stall and a roofed well, standing props, while the candidate is a large fenced crop field, so the kind comparison is only loose. The candidate has rich texture: wheat with highlight flecks, leaf tufts in several greens, shaded cabbages with dark-green undersides, soil grain, and wood rails in 4-5 tan/brown steps. Outlines are dark brown beside wood and dark green beside leaves, so they are tinted rather than black. Tile density is high. It matches the Beodeul craft level, although the pale grey checker ground inside the fence is a plain flat pattern.
